config.title: background size, position, repeat

intro.title: background size, position, repeat
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a webpage that uses CSS to style a background image for a hero section. You will learn how to control the background image's size, position, and repeat behavior using the background-size, background-position, and background-repeat properties. The core programming concept is applying and combining these CSS properties to achieve precise visual layouts. The main technologies involved are CSS and HTML, focusing on styling a single element with a background image. By the end, you will be able to create a visually appealing background that fits perfectly within its container.
intro.usecase: The background-size, background-position, and background-repeat properties are essential for creating polished, visually consistent interfaces across modern web applications. Developers use these properties to control hero images that scale responsively across devices, to position subtle repeating patterns in dashboard panels or modal backgrounds, and to ensure decorative icons or textures align precisely within navigation elements or form sections. Mastering these properties allows you to implement design specifications accurately, whether you're building a marketing landing page with a full-cover background or an admin panel with tiled texture accents.

objectives: Apply the background-size property to scale an image to cover or contain an element.
Configure the background-position property to place an image at specific coordinates within an element.
Manipulate the background-repeat property to tile, space, or prevent repetition of an image.
Integrate multiple background properties in a single declaration to control image presentation.
Construct a CSS rule that uses background-size, background-position, and background-repeat together to achieve a specific visual layout.
Update an existing style sheet to modify background behavior for responsive design.
Control background image behavior by overriding default values with explicit property settings.

steps.title: Create a container element for background styling
steps.instruction: Create a div element with class 'background-demo' that will serve as our styling target
steps.hint: Start with a div element and give it a class attribute with the value 'background-demo'.
steps.expectedOutcome: A CSS rule for the .background-demo class is created, ready to receive background properties.
successCriteria: The CSS contains a .background-demo selector with an empty rule block.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're on the right track, but make sure you've created a CSS rule for the class 'background-demo' exactly as shown.
steps.feedbackWrong: Create a CSS rule for the class 'background-demo' to set up our styling target.

steps.title: Set a background image on the container
steps.instruction: Add a background-image property to the .background-demo class with a URL to an image (use a placeholder image URL like 'https://picsum.photos/800/400').
steps.hint: Use the background-image property with a url() value containing the image URL.
steps.expectedOutcome: The .background-demo class will have a background-image property with a valid URL.
successCriteria: The .background-demo selector includes a background-image property with a url() value.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You added a background-image property, but check the URL syntax. It should be url('your-image-url').
steps.feedbackWrong: The background-image property is missing or incorrect. Make sure to add background-image: url('your-image-url'); inside .background-demo.

steps.title: Set background-repeat to no-repeat
steps.instruction: Add the background-repeat property with the value 'no-repeat' to the .background-demo rule to prevent the image from tiling.
steps.hint: Use the CSS property background-repeat: no-repeat; inside the .background-demo selector.
steps.expectedOutcome: The .background-demo rule now includes background-repeat: no-repeat; to control how the background image repeats.
successCriteria: The CSS includes background-repeat: no-repeat; within the .background-demo selector.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're on the right track, but make sure you've added background-repeat: no-repeat; correctly.
steps.feedbackWrong: That doesn't seem right. Try adding background-repeat: no-repeat; to the .background-demo rule.

steps.title: Set background-size to cover
steps.instruction: Add the background-size property with the value 'cover' to the .background-demo rule to make the background image fill the entire container while maintaining its aspect ratio.
steps.hint: The background-size property controls how the background image is sized. Use 'cover' to scale the image to be as large as needed to cover the container area.
steps.expectedOutcome: The .background-demo rule now includes background-size: cover;
successCriteria: The CSS rule for .background-demo contains the property background-size with the value cover.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're on the right track, but make sure you've added the background-size property with the exact value 'cover'.
steps.feedbackWrong: The step requires adding the background-size property with the value 'cover' to the .background-demo rule. Please try again.

steps.title: Set background-position to center
steps.instruction: Add the background-position property to center the background image within the .background-demo container.
steps.hint: Use the property background-position with the value center.
steps.expectedOutcome: The background image will be centered horizontally and vertically within the container.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're close. Make sure you've added the background-position property with the value center.
steps.feedbackWrong: The background-position property is missing or incorrect. Try adding background-position: center; to the .background-demo selector.

steps.title: Add a second container with different background-repeat
steps.instruction: Create a second CSS rule for a class named 'repeat-demo' that sets background-repeat to repeat-x.
steps.hint: Define a new CSS selector starting with .repeat-demo and add the background-repeat property with the value repeat-x.
steps.expectedOutcome: A second CSS rule is added with the class .repeat-demo and background-repeat: repeat-x.
successCriteria: The CSS contains a .repeat-demo selector with background-repeat: repeat-x.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You've added a CSS rule, but check that it uses the exact class name 'repeat-demo' and sets background-repeat to repeat-x.
steps.feedbackWrong: The CSS rule for .repeat-demo with background-repeat: repeat-x is missing or incorrect.

steps.title: Add a third container with background-size: contain
steps.instruction: Create a new CSS rule for a class named 'contain-demo' and set its background-size property to 'contain'.
steps.hint: Start by writing a new CSS selector that begins with '.contain-demo' and add a background-size property inside its curly braces.
steps.expectedOutcome: A new CSS rule for the 'contain-demo' class with background-size: contain will be added to the stylesheet.
successCriteria: The CSS contains a rule for the class 'contain-demo' with the property 'background-size: contain'.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're close. Make sure you've created a CSS rule for the class 'contain-demo' and set its background-size property to 'contain'.
steps.feedbackWrong: That doesn't match what we need. Please create a new CSS rule for a class named 'contain-demo' and set its background-size property to 'contain'.

steps.title: Add descriptive text and basic layout styling
steps.instruction: Add a new CSS rule for a class named 'demo-container' that sets display to flex, flex-direction to column, and adds 20px of gap between child elements.
steps.hint: Create a new CSS selector starting with .demo-container and define the flexbox properties inside curly braces.
steps.expectedOutcome: A new CSS rule for .demo-container is added with flexbox layout properties to organize the background examples.
successCriteria: The .demo-container rule includes display: flex, flex-direction: column, and gap: 20px.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You've added some styling, but make sure to include all three properties: display: flex, flex-direction: column, and gap: 20px.
steps.feedbackWrong: The CSS rule is missing or doesn't match the required properties. Check that you've created a .demo-container rule with the correct flexbox values.
